attacks.name: Bell-Borne Geochelone - Echo Skill
attacks.sourceText:
Activate the protection of Bell-Borne Geochelone. Deal Glacio DMG based on 91.20% of the current character's DEF to nearby enemies, and obtain a Bell-Borne Shield that lasts for 15s
The Bell-Borne Shield provides 50.00% DMG Reduction and 10.00% DMG Boost for the current team members, and disappears after the current character is hit for 3 times.
